$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Experiments settings: taste prototypes, one switch each, all off by default. gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. The App pushes every experiments.* toggle to each agent page as one object (AgentPanePageSettings, cmuxAcpmuxBridge.applyExperiments, webviews/src/experiments/switches.ts), so a new prototype adds only its row here. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: experiments
lists.note: Settings > Advanced > Experiments: taste prototypes, each behind its own switch, all off by default.

rows.note: Taste prototype: the agent chat header's buttons draw as round glass buttons, related actions share one glass capsule, with a search chip and shortcut keycaps (webviews useExperimentSwitch("glassToolbarGroups")). Off by default; off keeps today's header.

help.text: The chat header's buttons become round glass buttons, with related actions sharing one glass capsule, a search chip and shortcut keycaps.

rows.note: Taste prototype: the agent chat composer as a glass panel with an edge light on focus, mode and scope chips in a row inside it (only the active one raised), inline @mention chips, the model picker left and + and Send right, and a round Send dimmed until there is text (webviews useExperimentSwitch("composerV2"), composerV2.css). Off by default; off keeps today's composer.

help.text: The chat composer becomes a glass panel with mode chips, mention chips and a round Send button.

rows.note: Taste prototype: one restyled look for every tooltip and hover card in the web UI (Base UI tooltips, title tooltips, toolbar hints, hover cards): a frostier glass with a crisp hairline ring and a soft two-layer shadow, painted by the page instead of the App's glass (webviews useExperimentSwitch("hoverLook"), ui/hoverLook.css; arms in ui/hoverLook.experiment.ts). Paint only: sizes, padding and type do not change. Off by default; off keeps today's tooltips.

help.text: Tooltips and hover cards get a crisper glass, a sharper edge and a softer shadow.

rows.note: Taste build 5 (2026-11-19): agent counts and status on the tab strip and the sidebar, drawn natively (CmuxNextTabs TabCell+CountPill, CmuxNextSidebar WorkspaceRowView+AgentPill; DesignSettings.agentBadges). An agent chat tab shows a neutral count pill (unread plus a pending approval) in a slot always as wide as "99+", so no tab moves; a sidebar row shows one tinted status pill (Running, Needs approval, Done) in a slot as wide as the widest label. Off by default; off keeps today's marks.

help.text: Agent tabs show a count of unread messages and approvals, and sidebar rows show a status pill: Running, Needs approval or Done.

rows.note: Taste build 5's variant: with Agent Badges on, a running sidebar row's edge carries a thin light that laps it (Core Animation, Motion.indicators; still under Reduce Motion), removed when the row stops running or leaves the screen. No effect while Agent Badges is off.

help.text: With Agent Badges on, a thin light travels along a sidebar row's edge while its agent runs.
